name: Kobayashi Reina
source:
Class: 1st year student in the regular class
Zodiac Sign: Scorpio
Musical Instrument: Guitar
Hobbies: Listening to music, playing in her music band

A cool girl who loves playing in a music band. Her tone is always calm, even when her speech is acrimonious.
Basically, one of Reina's best sides is that she's caring; she cannot help but lend a hand to a person in need .
In contrary to appearance she eats a lot. She can easily eat 10 Viking Cakes(?). She likes sweets that much she always has some candy, hidden in her pockets, for example. Also, she loves cute things. 
Reina and her band were doing live concerts a long time ago, her guitar-playing skills are highly respected amongst other guitarists that have heard her playing back then..

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=660669]Getchu (NSFW)[/url].]
